definitions.short: to be strong ; causatively, to strengthen , i.e. (figuratively) to save (by flight)
definitions.full: H5756. uz [ עוּז ], עוֺז verb take or seek refuge (Arabic , take refuge, seek protection , a refuge ); — Qal Infinitive construct בְּמָעוֺז לָעוֺז Isa 30:2 (|| בְּ לַחְסוֺת ). Hiph`il bring into safety , Perfect 3 masculine plural הֵעִ֫יזוּ Isa 10:31 , object omitted, and so Imperative masculine plural הָעִ֫יזוּ Jer 4:6 , מִקֶּרֶב הָעִ֫זוּ 6:1 ; with accusative, masculine singular הָעֵז Exod 9:19 .
